headline: Govt seeks data on vacancies to hire 100,000 health workers
summary: The Ministry of Health and Family Welfare has ordered an updated list of vacancies to implement an election manifesto promise.
details: The government is seeking updated information on existing manpower and vacant positions within the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare to implement the goal of hiring 100,000 health workers.
caption:
100,000 new health workers? The government is now moving to fulfill its election manifesto promise.

The government is seeking updated information on existing manpower and vacant positions within the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare to implement the goal of hiring 100,000 health workers.

headline_marked: Titas Gas warns of [[scams targeting gas bill payments]]
headline: Titas Gas warns of scams targeting gas bill payments
summary: The gas distribution company has issued an urgent alert for customers to stay vigilant against fraudulent activities regarding bill payments.
details: Titas Gas Transmission and Distribution Company Limited has issued an urgent warning to its customers regarding a rise in fraudulent activities related to gas bill payments.
Fraudsters are reportedly using various traps to deceive customers into paying their bills through unofficial or unauthorized channels.
The company has urged all consumers to be cautious and avoid sharing personal information or making payments to unknown sources.
Customers are advised to use only official Titas Gas payment methods and verified platforms to ensure their bills are settled correctly.
The authority emphasized that any payment made to unauthorized persons or links will not be recognized as a valid bill payment.
caption:
Beware of gas bill scams! Titas Gas warns customers to avoid unauthorized payment channels.

Titas Gas Transmission and Distribution Company Limited has issued an urgent warning to its customers regarding a rise in fraudulent activities related to gas bill payments.

Fraudsters are reportedly using various traps to deceive customers into paying their bills through unofficial or unauthorized channels.

The company has urged all consumers to be cautious and avoid sharing personal information or making payments to unknown sources.

Customers are advised to use only official Titas Gas payment methods and verified platforms to ensure their bills are settled correctly.

The authority emphasized that any payment made to unauthorized persons or links will not be recognized as a valid bill payment.

#TitasGas #GasBill #ScamAlert #Bangladesh #ConsumerProtection

Source: Somoy News
tweet: Beware of gas bill scams! Titas Gas warns customers to avoid unauthorized payment channels and use only official payment methods. #TitasGas #ScamAlert #Bangladesh
